correctness.rationale: The 3-vertex host motifs are exactly classified by two positive consecutive gaps at n>6m; connected two-edge tree events have exact p^2 q^(6m-4) or p^2 q^(6m-5) weights. Centering gives n m^2 p^2 q^(6m)->e^(-c)/36. For r vertex-disjoint tree witnesses, at most 9*choose(r,2) cross edges are double-imposed closed, giving uniform joint-to-product error o(1); vertex overlaps exclude simultaneous components and their candidate fraction is O_r(1/n). The resulting mixed factorial moments prove the marked Poisson point-process convergence, and actual three-cycles have vanishing expectation. An independent finite enumeration checker passed 59,808 rational/numerical assertions; finite data are corroboration, not a limit proof.
